title: Effective Federal Funds Rate (DFF) Daily Snapshot
summary: The Effective Federal Funds Rate (DFF) remained flat at 3.64% from April 6 through April 10, 2026, with zero absolute change over the period. This represents the actual overnight lending rate between depository institutions, distinct from the Fed's policy target rate.
key_points: Rate has been stable at 3.64% for at least 5 consecutive trading days (April 6-10, 2026)
why_it_matters: The effective federal funds rate is a key benchmark for short-term borrowing costs across the financial system. A flat rate over multiple days indicates no overnight funding stress and suggests the Fed's policy stance remains unchanged during this period.
macro_context: The effective federal funds rate at 3.64% reflects current monetary policy implementation. The stability suggests the Fed's target range (typically 3.50-3.75% based on the effective rate of 3.64%) is being maintained without market stress in overnight funding markets.
